title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'win the Senate race' vs rule 'sworn in' - resolves on swearing-in or media consensus call, not vote count/certification

notes: SENATEPARTY.pdf read in full. Run date is Nov 7 2026 (after the Nov 3 2026 election) yet R quotes 0.38/0.39 - implies race not yet called by 4/8 sources or stale/inconsistent data; verify current race status before relying. Race-call status not verified in this run.
tie_handling: Not addressed; party of the first person sworn in decides. If winner changes party between election and swearing-in, party on election day governs. Vacancy before seating: party of first person sworn in as temporary or permanent replacement.
